name: aipet
description: Shows each Codex chat's status on the AiPet desktop pet. Needs the AiPet app running; does nothing otherwise.

interface.shortDescription: Show your Codex chats on the AiPet desktop pet
interface.longDescription: A floating pixel pet that mirrors your chats. The hook only observes: it prints nothing to Codex and does nothing while the pet is closed.
